name: crypto.hash
doc: Cryptographic digests: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-2 and BLAKE2b, one-shot and streaming.

items.name: Blake2b
items.doc: Blake2b returns the BLAKE2b digest of data (RFC 7693) with size 1..64 bytes and an optional key of up to 64 bytes.
items.summary: Blake2b returns the BLAKE2b digest of data (RFC 7693) with size 1..64 bytes and an optional key of up to 64 bytes.

items.name: Crc32
items.doc: Crc32 returns the IEEE CRC-32 of data.
items.summary: Crc32 returns the IEEE CRC-32 of data.

items.name: Md5
items.doc: Md5 returns the MD5 digest of data (not for security).
items.summary: Md5 returns the MD5 digest of data (not for security).

items.name: Md5Hex
items.doc: Md5Hex returns the MD5 digest of data in lowercase hex.
items.summary: Md5Hex returns the MD5 digest of data in lowercase hex.

items.name: Sha1

items.summary: Sha1 returns the SHA-1 digest of data.

items.name: Sha1Hex

items.summary: Sha1Hex returns the SHA-1 digest of data in lowercase hex.

items.name: Sha256

items.name: Sha256Hex

items.summary: Sha256Hex returns the SHA-256 digest of data in lowercase hex.

items.name: Sha384

items.name: Sha512

items.summary: Sha512Hex returns the SHA-512 digest of data in lowercase hex.

items.name: Sum
items.doc: Sum returns the digest of data with alg ("md5", "sha1", "sha256", "sha384", "sha512").
items.summary: Sum returns the digest of data with alg ("md5", "sha1", "sha256", "sha384", "sha512").
